snippet.title: Survive The Fall | RELEASE TRAILER EN
snippet.description:
The world has ended – but your story has just begun.

Survive the Fall is more than a game. It's a fight for survival in an open, destroyed world.
Explore abandoned ruins, face brutal enemies and build a new refuge in the midst of chaos.

Uncover the past. Perish or find hope in the end.

What’s left when everything falls? Find it out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1579340/Survive_the_Fall/

About Toplitz Productions

Named after the mystic “Toplitz Lake” which is situated in a dense mountain forest high up in the Alps, Toplitz Productions was founded with the aim of developing and publishing computer and video games “with heart and soul”.
For more information, visit toplitz-productions.com.
